summary: Canoe capsized at night with a couple and their dog aboard; the female and dog swam to shore and spent the night stranded on cliffs north of the lake; the male was unable to reach shore and drowned, his body found the next morning by good samaritans; the female was treated at Valley View Hospital and released.
responding_agency: Garfield County Sheriff's Office, Garfield County SAR, Gypsum Fire Department, USFS
notes: Deputies notified 2022-06-22 of the stranded female; incident occurred the night before (2022-06-21); fills a 2022 thin year for Garfield
